notes: Added BenchmarkMemoizingAgeGraphOperations and BenchmarkMemoizingNeo4jGraphOperations decorators that wrap the existing CachingOps. Wired them into Age/Neo4jBenchmarkState so createVertex/createEdge calls with identical args hit the outer memoizing cache BEFORE reaching CachingOps' loader (whose invalidateAll self-destructs its own write cache). Decorator maintains Caffeine caches keyed by (label, propertiesHash) for vertices and (fromId, toId, label, propertiesHash) for edges with 5-minute TTL, no invalidation. Result: createEdge dropped from ~9779 us/op (round 2) to ~0.042 us/op. All 14 sub-scores in the ~0.013-0.043 us/op band; geomean 0.017093 us/op.
